summary.key_theme: 市場高度期待 Quanta Services 受惠於人工智慧驅動的電力需求與電網現代化建設，儘管股價近期出現短期波動，但分析師普遍看好其財報表現與長期成長潛力。

bullish.title: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on Quanta Services, Raises Price Target to $960
bullish.reason: 分析師 Jamie Cook 維持買入評級並大幅上調目標價至 960 美元，顯示對公司在基礎設施領域的強勁成長信心。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR) Shows High Growth and Improving Fundamentals Across the Board
bullish.reason: 公司通過了八項成長篩選指標，在銷售額、每股盈餘動能及利潤率方面表現優異，基本面強勁。

bullish.title: Best Stocks to Buy Now Before Earnings and Hold: PWR
bullish.reason: 被視為人工智慧驅動能源需求下的最佳純概念股之一，適合在財報公布前布局並長期持有。

bullish.title: 3 Reasons Why Growth Investors Shouldn't Overlook Quanta Services (PWR)
bullish.reason: 強調其具備卓越的成長屬性，對於尋求長期資本增值的成長型投資人具有高度吸引力。

bullish.title: Quanta Services, Inc. (PWR) Offers Exposure to Grid Modernization and AI Infrastructure
bullish.reason: Polen Capital 在其投資策略中將 Quanta Services 列為電網現代化與 AI 基礎設施的關鍵曝險標的。

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Suffers a Larger Drop Than the General Market: Key Insights
bearish.reason: 股價單日下跌 8.1%，跌幅超過大盤，反映出市場對其高估值的短期修正壓力。

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Looks Stretched Despite Its 370% Five Year Run
bearish.reason: 儘管五年內漲幅達 370%，但市場開始擔憂估值過高（Stretched），可能面臨獲利回吐壓力。

bearish.title: Quanta Stock Falls on Target Cut, but Analysts See 30% Upside
bearish.reason: 曾因目標價遭下調導致股價下跌，但整體分析師仍認為具備 30% 的上漲空間，利空影響有限。

neutral.title: Earnings to watch: Quanta (PWR) reports Q3 results tomorrow
neutral.reason: 僅為財報發布前的例行性提醒，市場正密切關注其 Q3 業績表現。

neutral.title: Is Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Outpacing Its Construction Peers This Year?
neutral.reason: 對比 Quanta Services 與 United Rentals 的年度績效，屬於中性的產業比較分析。

neutral.title: GEV, D, CMS, AEP And PWR To Report Earnings This Week
neutral.reason: 列出本週即將公布財報的電力與公用事業公司，屬於市場行事曆資訊。
